text: Ek phalwaale ke paas kuchh santare the. He sold 40 oranges in the morning. Shaam ko uske paas jitne santare the, unmein se aadhe usne bech diye. At the end he had 35 oranges. Shuru mein uske paas kitne santare the?
A hostel sets aside 2.4 kg of tea leaves for 6 days. The daily quantity is used to make 40 L of tea. How many grams of leaves are used per litre?
An auto fare is INR 35 for the first kilometre and INR 12 for each further kilometre. There is no waiting charge. What is the fare for exactly 6 km?
Ravaangi ka niyam assigns 2 loading helpers for every 5 vehicles. Ek paali mein 35 gaadiyan hain. Niyam ke anusaar kitne sahaayak hain?
Ek badhai makes pieces 30 cm long from a plank that is 2.4 metres long. Use kitne tukde milenge?
Baag ka taapmaapi asli taapmaan se 2 degree selsiyas kam dikhata hai; abhi -1 degree selsiyas hai. What is the actual temperature in degrees Celsius?
Ek kisan ne aam aur neembu ke ped lagaaye. He planted four times as many lemon trees as mango trees, aur total 85 ped lagaaye. Usne neembu ke kitne ped lagaaye?
A delivery vehicle covers 27 km in 45 minutes at steady speed. What is that speed in kilometres per hour?
An event hall has 96 chairs. Staff remove 14 for a camera lane, then put 6 of those chairs along the back wall. How many chairs are in the hall afterward?
Mele mein ek khilauna gaadi 120 rupaye ki hai, and a doll costs 45 rupees more than the toy car. Neha ek khilauna gaadi aur ek gudiya khareedti hai. Woh kitne rupaye kharch karti hai?

A dispatch board shows 18 parcels awaiting pickup and 7 already on vehicles. Its target is 31 parcels in these two states combined. How many further parcels must enter either state to meet the target?
Daftar ki do duty avadhiyan 09:10 se 10:00 aur 09:35 se 10:20 tak hain, ek hi din. For how many minutes do they overlap?
Samaan ki gaadi sthir raftaar par 45 minute mein 27 km chalti hai. Uski raftaar kitne km prati ghanta hai?
Ek bachat yojana mein you earn 45 rupees of interest in one month. 1080 rupaye byaaj milne mein kitne maheene lagenge?
Ajay ki gaadi ki tanki mein kuchh tel tha. Usne 18 litre tel aur daala, to tanki mein pehle se tigna tel ho gaya. Shuru mein tanki mein kitne litre tel tha?
Ek gaadi ne 320 km ki doori tay ki. Iska 35 pratishat raajmaarg par tha aur baaki gaon ki sadkon par. Gaon ki sadkon par kitne kilometre gaadi chali?
A tailor stitches 3 shirts in 2 hours. How many shirts will he stitch in 10 hours?
Sand and cement are mixed in the ratio 4 : 1. A mason uses 6 bags of cement. How many bags of sand does he need?
Ek pyaala chaay 10 rupaye ki hai. 3 samose aur 2 pyaale chaay 80 rupaye ke hain. Ek samosa kitne rupaye ka hai?
Samaroh ke pravesh par 24 log intezaar mein hain. Ek minute mein 5 aate hain aur 8 ko andar liya jaata hai. Pankti pehli baar khaali hone mein kitne minute lagenge?
A tailor takes 75 minutes to stitch a shirt. Stitching a pair of pyjamas takes 20 minutes less than stitching a shirt. How many minutes does he need to stitch one shirt and one pair of pyjamas?
A batter scored 80 runs in an innings, and 45% of those runs came from fours and sixes. How many of the batter's runs did not come from fours and sixes?
A train has 1200 seats. On Monday, 3/5 of the seats were reserved in advance and another 150 seats were reserved on the day of travel. How many seats remained empty?

Doorbhaash mein theek 27 MB jagah khaali hai. Samaan aakaar ki chhoti chalchitra sanchikaaon mein ek sanchika dhan poornank MB leti hai; alag se koi jagah nahin lagti. Paanch sanchika samaati hain, chhah nahin. Ek sanchika kitne MB ki hai?

Pustakalay ka kitab sukhaane wala yantra ek chakkar mein adhiktam 8 kitabein leta hai. Ek chakkar 15 minute hai aur chakkar kram se chalte hain. Rakhne mein samay na lage to 19 geeli kitabein kitne minute mein sookhengi?
Daftar ke karmachari ko apni chhapaai ke INR 430 dene the. Vetan se INR 500 roke gaye aur phir INR 40 lautaye gaye. Ab karmachari ko aur kitne rupaye lautaane hain?
Kavya ke paas 500 rupaye the. She bought a bag for 275 rupees and a pencil box for 95 rupees. Ab uske paas kitne rupaye hain?
A school library had 245 storybooks. During reading week, 87 books were issued to students and 19 books were sent away for repair. How many storybooks are still on the library shelves?
Chhatravaas ke safai ghol mein saandr drav aur paani 1:7 mein hain: 2 L saandr drav aur 14 L paani. Sirf 2 L paani bhaap banta hai. Ab paani ko saandr drav ki matra se vibhaajit karne par kya milega?
Ek kabaddi tournament mein ek team ne 16 mukaable khele, and it won 75% of them. Jo mukaable team nahi jeeti, unmein se aadhe haari, and the remaining matches were tied. Kitne mukaable tie hue?
Samaan pahunchane ke raaste ke teen khand 4 km, 7 km aur 3 km hain. The direct road between the same endpoints is 9 km. Usse kitne km ki bachat hogi?
At a Lohri gathering, some peanuts were shared equally among 8 children. Each child got 15 peanuts, and 6 peanuts were left over. How many peanuts were there?
Ek kaarigar mahila kapde ke thaile banaati hai. Ek thaile ke saamaan par 35 rupaye lagte hain aur woh har thaila 80 rupaye mein bechti hai. 25 thaile bechne par use kitna munaafa hoga?
Udyan ke nakshay mein 45% kshetra van aur 30% ghaas hai; dono kshetra alag hain. Van se baahar ke kshetra ke mukable ghaas ka kshetra kitne % hai?
A box of 6 pencils costs 54 rupees. Asha buys 4 boxes and one eraser that costs 8 rupees. How much does she pay?
An event sound bill is INR 3600. A sponsor pays INR 900, and the unpaid amount is divided equally among 3 organising groups. How much does each group pay?
An office backup begins at 23:40 and ends at 01:15 the next day. It pauses for 10 minutes within that interval. How many minutes is it actively running?
Lohri par kuch moongphaliyaan were shared equally among 8 children. Each child got 15 peanuts, and 6 were left over. Kitni moongphaliyaan thi?
Pustakalay ko marammat ke liye INR 800 ka anudaan mila hai. Jildsaazi ka kharch INR 1055 hai, par jildsaaz INR 55 maaf karta hai. Pustakalay ko apni nidhi se kitne rupaye dene hain?
Kamla 25 rupaye prati kilo ke bhaav se kuchh aaloo aur 30 rupaye ki ek gaddi dhaniya khareedti hai. Woh kul 205 rupaye deti hai. Usne kitne kilo aaloo khareede?
Doorbhash 30% se shuru hota hai. It gains 4 percentage points per minute for 5 minutes, then charges at half that speed for 3 minutes. Ant mein kitne % par pahunchega?
Daftar ki ghanti 09:00 se har 12 minute par bajti hai. How many reminders sound through 10:00, including both endpoints?
One kilogram of rice costs 45 rupees. 2.4 kilo chaawal kitne rupaye ka hoga?
Baarish ka paani jama karne ki vyavastha ki jaanch INR 600 ki hai. Is par 10 pratishat seva shulk lagta hai, phir INR 50 ki chhoot hai. What is the amount payable in rupees?
Baag ke mitti maapak par nami 24 pratishat se 39 pratishat ho jaati hai. What is the increase as a percentage of the original reading?
Chikitsaalay mein 6 mulaqaton ki pustika INR 450 ki hai; alag mulaqat INR 90 ki. How much does the booklet save against paying individually for 6 visits?
A bus has 52 seats. On Friday morning, 9 seats were empty. On Saturday morning, 5 fewer passengers were seated than on Friday morning. How many passengers were seated on Saturday morning?
Doorbhash ki marammat ka daam rises by 20 percent, then falls by 20 percent of the new price. Antim daam mool daam ka kitna percent hai?
Arun spent one-fourth of his savings on a watch repair and then 600 rupees on books. He had 1,500 rupees left. How much money did he have at first?

Do kakshaon mein chhaatron ki sankhya baraabar hai. Agar kaksha A se 6 chhaatra kaksha B mein chale jaayen, to kaksha B mein kaksha A ke 2 guna chhaatra ho jaayenge. Abhi har kaksha mein kitne chhaatra hain?
Samaan ki gaadi sthir raftaar par 45 minute mein 27 km chalti hai. What is its speed in kilometres per hour?
A phone has exactly 27 MB free. Identical clips each occupy a positive whole number of MB, with no storage overhead. Five clips fit, but six do not. How many MB does one clip occupy?
Pustakalay ka nakal yantra ek minute mein 6 double-sided sheets deta hai, one page per side. Sab taraf chhaapne par 144 pannon ke liye kitne minute chahiye?
Do doorbhash yojanaon ka maasik daam samaan hai aur baatcheet ke 180 aur 240 minute milte hain. Pehli mein ek minute ke daam ko doosri ke ek minute ke daam se vibhaajit karne par kya milega?
An office allows 18 minutes of late arrival per week before a warning. A worker's recorded delay is 7 minutes more than this allowance. What delay is recorded?
Baag ke mitti maapak par nami 24 pratishat se 39 pratishat ho jaati hai. Shuruaati maap ke mukable vriddhi kitne pratishat hai?
Two classes have the same number of students. If 6 students move from Class A to Class B, Class B will have twice as many students as Class A. How many students are in each class now?
Aspataal upkaran ki jama raashi INR 900 mein se patti ke INR 120 aur safai ke INR 45 kaat leta hai. How much of the deposit is refunded in rupees?
Ek cricket team ko jeetne ke liye 260 runs chahiye. The two openers scored 94 runs, aur middle order ne 117 runs aur banaye. How many more runs does the team need to win?
Doorbhash ki marammat ka shulk chhoot se pehle INR 670 hai. Us shulk ke INR 100 ke ek poore samooh par INR 10 ki chhoot milti hai. Antim shulk kitne rupaye hai?
Ek train mein 1200 seats hain. Somvaar ko 3/5 of the seats were reserved in advance, aur 150 seats yatra ke din book hui. How many seats remained empty?

Deepak ki maheene ki tankhwaah 18000 rupaye hai. Woh 11500 rupaye ghar ke kharchon par lagaata hai aur baaki paise har maheene bachat khaate mein jama karta hai. 4 maheene mein woh kitne rupaye jama karega?
The length and width of a rectangular room are in the ratio 3 : 2. The width of the room is 4 metres. What is the perimeter of the room?
Pustakalay mein hastalipi ki nakal ka shulk INR 240 hai; paathak INR 300 deta hai aur INR 25 chhutte se daan karta hai. How many rupees should be given vaapas?
Ek aayataakaar farsh ki chaudaai ko 3 metre badhaane par uski lambaai milti hai. The perimeter of the floor is 26 metres. Farsh ki chaudaai kitni hai?
Pustakalay ka kamra 55 minute ke liye tay hai. Taiyari mein 8 minute aur paath mein 32 minute lagte hain. Isi avadhi mein charcha ke liye kitne minute baaki hain?
Chhatravaas ki rasoi mein 72 thaaliyan taiyar hui. Eleven untouched trays remain, and another 4 were spoiled before service. Kitni thaaliyan parosi gayin?
Aspataal ki raseed ka total is INR 1750, including an INR 250 consultation. Beema jaanch ka aadha kharch deta hai, paraamarsh ka kuchh nahi. Mareez kitne rupaye dega?
A library charges INR 240 to reproduce a manuscript. The reader pays INR 300 and asks that INR 25 of the change become a donation. How many rupees should the library give back?
Ek darzi salwar-kameez silne ke 400 rupaye leta tha. He increased his stitching charge by 12 percent. Ab woh kitne rupaye leta hai?
At an event, 3/4 of the invitations receive a reply. Of the replies, 4/5 are acceptances. If 48 invitations are accepted, how many invitations were sent?
Aspataal ki rapat 80 pannon ki hai; 3/8 hissa aarekhon ka aur unmein aadhe ki rangeen nakal chahiye. How many pages require a colour copy?
A garden sensor rental costs INR 95 a day. The sensor is collected Monday morning and returned Thursday evening; both collection and return days are charged. What is the rental bill?
Doorbhash par baatcheet ki seema 200 se 250 minute ho jaati hai. Nayi seema mein kitne pratishat ki katauti se puraani seema milegi?
Ek rajaai banaane waali laal aur neele tukdon ko 2 : 3 ke anupaat mein lagaati hai. Woh kul 45 tukde lagaati hai. Woh kitne neele tukde lagaati hai?
Tipahiya 30 minute mein 12 km chalta, 10 minute rukta aur phir 20 minute mein 8 km chalta hai. Is poore beete ghante mein ausat raftaar kitne km ek ghante mein hai?
Bus mein ek vayask ka tikat 85 rupaye aur ek bachche ka tikat 45 rupaye hai. 2 vayask aur 3 bachchon wala ek parivaar is bus se safar karta hai. Unke tikaton par kitne rupaye kharch honge?
Two flower beds have 52 plants altogether. The first bed has 8 more plants than the second. How many plants are there in the second bed?
Daftar mein charcha aur shaant kaam ka samay 2:5 mein hai; shaant kaam 35 minute hai. Discussion ends 3 minutes earlier than planned. Woh kitne minute chalti hai?
Ek aayataakaar kamre ki lambaai aur chaudaai 3 : 2 ke anupaat mein hain. The width of the room is 4 metres. What is the perimeter of the room?
Ek safar mein, the distances driven on the first and second days were in the ratio 4 : 3. Doosre din parivaar ne 210 km gaadi chalaayi. How many kilometres did they drive in total over the two days?
Pustakalay ki almaari par bhare sthaan ki bhinn 18/30 likhi hai. Is bhinn ke saraltam roop ka har kya hai?

Ek kala adhyaapika ne rangeen kaagaz ki kuchh gaddiyaan, 35 rupaye ki ek gaddi ke hisaab se, aur 20 rupaye waali 4 gond ki sheeshiyaan khareedin. Usne 395 rupaye kharch kiye. Usne kaagaz ki kitni gaddiyaan khareedin?
Samaan pahunchane wale ki afternoon distance is 6 km more than the morning distance. Dopahar mein 23 km darj hain. Subah kitne km chale the?
Ek vidyalay ke pustakalay mein har 3 angrezi kitaabon par 5 Hindi kitaabein hain. Agar 120 Hindi kitaabein hain, to angrezi kitaabein kitni hain?
A delivery route has three legs of 4 km, 7 km and 3 km. A direct road between the same start and finish is 9 km. How many kilometres would using the direct road save?
Raksha Bandhan ke liye Neha ne 6 rakhiyaan kharidi at ₹45 each, aur ₹320 ka mithai ka dibba liya. She paid with a ₹1000 note. Use kitne rupaye change mile?
Bageeche ki paani ki tanki ko ek nal 6 ghante mein aur doosra nal 3 ghante mein bharta hai. Dono nal milkar tanki ko kitne ghante mein bharenge?
Ek passenger train apne raaste mein 9 padaavon par 2-2 minute rukti hai, and it is moving for 72 minutes. Poori yatra mein kitne ghante lagte hain?
Ek rasoiya khichdi ke liye chaawal aur daal ko vazan ke hisaab se 3:1 mein milaata hai. 2 kg mishran banaane ke liye kitne gram chaawal chahiye?
A hostel tank starts full. Breakfast uses 1/4 of its water and lunch uses 1/3 of the original full amount. What fraction of the original water remains?
A cook mixes rice and lentils in the ratio 3:1 by weight to make khichdi. How many grams of rice are needed to make 2 kg of the mixture?
The savings of Neha and Ravi are in the ratio 3 : 5. Ravi saved 3,000 rupees. How much did Neha save?
A school ordered 500 notebooks for its annual exams. Class 6 received 135 notebooks, Class 7 received 142 and Class 8 received 158. How many notebooks have not yet been given to any class?
A 1.5-litre bottle of mango juice is opened. 2/5 of the juice is served at lunch and 0.4 litres at dinner. How many litres of juice are still in the bottle?
Ek school mein 480 students hain, and each student chose exactly one hobby club. Unmein se 3/8 ne dance chuna, 1/4 ne music, and the rest chose art. Kitne students ne art chuna?
An office reimburses travel up to INR 500 per trip. A worker spends INR 640 on travel and INR 90 on meals; meals are not reimbursed. What is the worker's unreimbursed expense?
A weather station records a day's lowest temperature as -3 degrees Celsius and highest as 8 degrees Celsius. What is the temperature range in degrees Celsius?
A sports shop sells a cricket ball for ₹275 and a pair of batting gloves for ₹1150. A sports club buys 8 balls and 2 pairs of gloves. How much does the club pay?

A library wants its repaired-to-awaiting-repair book ratio to equal 3:2. It has 24 repaired books and 20 awaiting repair. Without changing any book's state, how many already-repaired donated books are needed?
Dooth ki saamaan-sahit aur khaali doori 5:2 mein hai. Saamaan-sahit doori 30 km hai. Poore safar ke mukable khaali safar ki bhinnatmak matra kya hai?

Three hostel meal accounts start with the same balance. Deductions of INR 6, INR 9 and INR 12 are made from the respective accounts. The balances afterward total INR 99. What was the starting balance of one account?
Baag ki sinchaai ke khaate mein INR 75 jama hain; naya shulk INR 380 hai. A late fee of INR 20 also applies. Khaata chukane ke liye kitne rupaye dene hain?
Ek paani ki tanki mein 1200 litre paani aata hai. Abhi woh do-tihaai bhari hai. Use oopar tak bharne ke liye aur kitne litre paani chahiye?
In a football season, a team's wins and losses were in the ratio 5:2, and it lost 6 matches. No match was drawn. How many matches did it play?
Baag ki boond sinchaai naali se 300 mL prati minute nikalta hai. 4.5 L chhodne mein kitne minute lagenge?
A delivery worker is paid INR 24 for a successful stop and INR 8 for an attempted but unsuccessful stop. Of 15 stops, 3 are unsuccessful. What is the worker's pay?
Ajay ki gaadi ki tanki mein kuchh tel tha. After he added 18 litres, the tank had three times as much fuel as before. Shuru mein tanki mein kitne litre tel tha?
Do pariyon mein Sana ne pehle x ran aur phir 2x + 5 ran banaye. Do pariyon mein usne 77 ran banaye. Doosri pari mein usne kitne ran banaye?
Doorbhash par dastaavez 18 pardo mein hai, ek par 20 panktiyan. The new size fits 30 lines per screen, with all lines fitting exactly. Kitne parde chahiye?
Daftar ke prashikshan kaksh mein saakshaatkaar kaksh ki 3 guna jagahen hain; saakshaatkaar kaksh mein 14 hain. How many seats are in the training room?
Diwali ke liye Kavya ne mitti ke 150 diye banaye. Usne padosiyon ko 4 darjan diye de diye aur ghar par 64 diye jalaaye. Kitne diye istemaal nahi hue?

Two delivery zones need 3 and 5 workers for equal coverage, but have 12 and 15 workers assigned. A coverage factor is assigned workers divided by required workers. What is the first factor divided by the second?
Shaadi ke aayataakaar shamiyane ki length is 4 m greater than its width. Uska parimaap 56 m hai. Chaudaai kitne m hai?

Aspataal ke do dal milkar 60 mulaqaton ki zimmedari lete hain. Ek dal 26 sambhalta hai. Mehmaan dal doosre dal ke zimmedari wale 9 sambhalta hai. Doosre niyamit dal ko khud kitni mulaqatein sambhalni hain?
Chhatravaas ki marammat nidhi mein INR 780 hain. INR 180 surakshit rakhne hain; bacha paisa INR 75 ke samaan kundi-saamaanon par lag sakta hai. Aise kitne kundi-saamaan liye ja sakte hain?
Bus ke raaste se, shahar se Q gaon ki doori P gaon ki doori se 35 km zyada hai. Dono dooriyon ka jod 145 km hai. How far is village P from the city by bus?

Samaan pahunchane ke do kshetron ko 3 aur 5 karmachari chahiye; lage hain 12 aur 15. Coverage factor is assigned workers divided by required workers. Samaan pahunch ke is maan mein pehle ko doosre se vibhaajit karne par kya milega?
A phone plan carries unused data into tomorrow, but only up to 2 GB. Today 3.5 GB is unused, and tomorrow's fresh allowance is 1.5 GB. How much data will be available tomorrow?
A driver drove at a steady speed for 3 hours and then drove another 40 km. In this way he covered 250 km. What was his speed in km/h during the first 3 hours?
Doorbhash seva mein INR 100 ka upyog-adhikaar INR 92 mein milta hai; vyakti aise 3 leta hai. After spending INR 245 of service credit, how much credit remains in rupees?
Ek recipe mein 900 g aata lagta hai. Two-thirds of the flour is wheat flour and the rest is besan. Recipe mein kitne gram besan lagta hai?
Ek rasoiye ke paas kuch aalu hain. Agar uske paas inke 3 guna se 8 zyada aalu hote, to 50 aalu hote. Uske paas kitne aalu hain?
In a school library, there are 5 Hindi books for every 3 English books. If there are 120 Hindi books, how many English books are there?
Do innings mein Sana scored x runs and then 2x + 5 runs. Do innings mein usne 77 runs banaye. Doosri innings mein usne kitne runs banaye?
Two hospital laundry pipes together fill a tank at 18 L per minute. An open outlet drains 5 L per minute. Starting empty, how much water is in the tank after 4 minutes?
Ek match mein Arjun aur Vikram ke runs 3:4 mein the. Arjun scored 57 runs. Vikram ne kitne runs banaye?
For a shopkeeper, the cost price and selling price of an iron wok are in the ratio 5 : 6. The cost price is 1,500 rupees. How much profit does he make on one wok?
Daftar mein 84 puraani sanchikayein hain. 2/7 ki yantrik chhavi bani hai. Aur 18 ki chhavi banne par kitni bhinnatmak matra ki chhavi ban chuki hogi?
Ek litre khaane ka tel 160 rupaye ka hai. What is the cost of 750 mL of oil?
Samatal zameen par ek hi samay 1.5 m khambhe ki chhaaya 2 m aur ped ki 8 m hai. Oonchai aur chhaaya ka sambandh dono mein samaan hai. Ped kitne m ooncha hai?
Rakesh ki maheene ki aamdani 20000 rupaye hai. He saves 15% of it. Woh maheene mein kitne rupaye kharch karta hai?
Baarish 2.5 ghante tak 6 mm prati ghanta hoti hai; pehle din ka maap 4 mm tha. What is the day's final reading in mm?
Ek kisan ne aam aur neembu ke ped lagaaye. Usne aam ke pedon ke 4 guna neembu ke ped lagaaye, aur kul 85 ped lagaaye. Usne neembu ke kitne ped lagaaye?
A library has 40 reference books, of which 10 are illustrated, and 60 lending books, of which 30 are illustrated. What fraction of all these books is illustrated?
Khet A mein 860 kg dhaan hua. Field B produced 135 kg less paddy than Field A. Dono kheton ka total production kitne kg hai?
Jaipur se Ajmer ka bus tikat ek vayask ke liye 160 rupaye aur ek bachche ke liye 90 rupaye ka hai. Sharma ji 2 vayaskon aur 3 bachchon ke tikat kharidte hain. Unhe kitne rupaye dene honge?
Sports teacher cricket practice ka samay batting aur bowling mein 3:2 mein lagaate hain. Practice lasts 90 minutes. Bowling par kitne minute lagte hain?
A class has boys and girls in the ratio 5:7. There are 20 boys. How many students are in the class?
School library mein there are 5 Hindi books for every 3 English books. Agar 120 Hindi kitaabein hain, to angrezi kitaabein kitni hain?
Aspataal ki kapdon ki gathri mein chaadarein, takiye ke gilaaf aur tauliye 2:3:4 mein hain. 27 vastuyein hain. Takiye ke kitne gilaaf hain?
Painting the living room costs 3,600 rupees. Painting the bedroom costs 1,150 rupees less than painting the living room. What is the total cost of painting both rooms?
Ek railgaadi 72 km prati ghanta ki chaal se chalti hai. 54 km ki doori tay karne mein use kitne minute lagenge?
Two brothers share 84 kg of chickpeas in the ratio 4:3, and the elder brother gets the larger share. How many more kilograms does the elder brother get than the younger brother?
Two bookmarks lie at pages 64 and 81 of a library volume. How many page numbers lie strictly between them?
In a cricket match, the Blue team scored 176 runs. The Green team scored 38 more runs than the Blue team. How many runs did the Green team score?
Ramesh hired 3 farm workers for 2 days, paying each worker ₹450 a day, and bought seeds worth ₹4200. He had set aside ₹10000 for these costs. How much of that amount is unspent?
x km ki pahunchaai par ek tipahiya seva ka bhaada INR (40 + 12*x) aur doosri ka INR (64 + 8*x) hai. At what distance in kilometres are the two quotes equal?
Dooth praaptakartaon se INR 1260 leta hai. Ismein se INR 60 ka tay shulk aur 8 gathriyan pahunchane ke liye ek gathri ke INR 15 kaat leta hai. Woh kitne rupaye jama karega?
Sanjay apni cycle ek sthir gati se chalaata hai aur ek ghante mein 15 km tay karta hai. 9 km tay karne mein use kitne minute lagenge?
Mele mein ek khilauna gaadi 120 rupaye ki hai aur ek gudiya khilauna gaadi se 45 rupaye zyada ki hai. Neha ek khilauna gaadi aur ek gudiya khareedti hai. Woh kitne rupaye kharch karti hai?
Meena ne 48 gulaab ke paudhe aur 29 gende ke paudhe lagaaye. Gulaab aur gende ke paudhon ki sankhya mein kitna antar hai?
The rail route from Agra to Bhopal is 505 km long. A train has covered 178 km before lunch and 142 km after lunch. How many kilometres of the journey are still to be covered?
Samaroh ke nimantranon mein 3/4 ka jawaab aata hai aur unmein 4/5 sveekriti hain. If 48 invitations are accepted, how many invitations were sent?
Pustakalay mein marammat-shuda aur bina marammat ki kitabein 2:3 mein hain. Adding 10 restored books makes the counts equal; no untreated books are added. Bina marammat ki kitni thi?
Pustakalay ka nakal yantra ek minute mein dono taraf chhape 6 kaagaz deta hai, ek taraf ek panna. Sab taraf chhaapne par 144 pannon ke liye kitne minute chahiye?
Bhor mein talaab ka paani chhalakne ke nishaan se 14 cm kam oonchai par hai. Baarish se paani 9 cm chadhta hai. Ab paani nishaan se kitne cm kam oonchai par hai?
In a recurring deposit scheme, you have to deposit 750 rupees per month. How much will be deposited in 2 years?
Shaadi ke aayataakaar shamiyane ki lambaai uski chaudaai se 4 m zyada hai. Uska parimaap 56 m hai. Chaudaai kitne m hai?
